title: Finite-strain and cohesive dynamic energy closure
purpose: Require energy evidence before a dynamic crack-speed claim is accepted.
physics: Total-Lagrangian Neo-Hookean dynamics with optional Mode-I cohesive separation

execution.evidence: A no-fracture wave packet checks conservative energy under mesh refinement. A split interface is then opened completely by a smooth prescribed motion and repeated with smaller time increments.

observables: Bulk recoverable energy and kinetic energy.
Cohesive stored energy and irreversible fracture dissipation.
Natural-load work and strong prescribed-motion work.
acceptance: Complete separation dissipates the declared fracture energy Gamma to absolute tolerance 1e-12.
The fine time-step final relative energy error is smaller than the coarse result and below 1e-5.
The no-fracture relative energy error decreases under spatial refinement.
limitations: The cohesive case is uniform Mode-I separation, not a propagating crack.
MPC, contact, and weak-constraint work require their own dual-variable definitions.
The benchmark covers the named compressible plane-strain model and parameter range.
